text:
Jordan P: Hey team — baby decided to come a week early. I need to start parental leave next Monday (will have exact time tomorrow). Quick questions: payroll cutoff implications, benefits paperwork timing, and oncall coverage handoff.

Asha (People Ops): Congrats Jordan!! :tada: Okay first, breathe :)
Asha (People Ops): Payroll: if leave starts before your next pay period starts we'll need the leave start date by EOD Fri to prorate pay codes correctly.
Asha (People Ops): Benefits: you can sign e-forms anytime but final enrollment changes need to be submitted within 30 days of leave start for FSA/HSA changes. I can send links.

Liam (Payroll): @Jordan P FYI payroll cutoff for next cycle is Sat 11:59pm PT. If payroll sees a LOA entry by then we mark the code as PARENTAL-PAID or UNP-PAID depending on your choice.
Liam (Payroll): If you want top-up from the company you need the signed top-up form — I can attach.

Jordan P: Thanks. Can you post the link(s) and the top-up form? I might only have wifi at hospital.

Asha (People Ops): Here are the links: https://redwood.hr/leave-forms and https://redwood.hr/top-up-form
Asha (People Ops): Top-up form = short e-sign (SSN last4 + manager sign). I can pre-fill manager field if you confirm Sofia.

Sofia (Eng Manager): Confirmed — I can sign. Jordan, when you have a minute DM me start/end window. We'll do a lightweight handoff doc.

Marco: For oncall — I can cover week 1 and week 3 if needed. Would you prefer rotation or single backup?

Jordan P: Marco huge help, thank you. Prefer single backup for continuity, but if load spikes we can rotate.

Sofia (Eng Manager): Cool. Jordan please drop a 1-paragraph handoff to #eng-oncall and ping Marco. Include active incidents, runbooks, and any commands. Example snippet:
```
Active keys: incident-2384 -> paging to infra
KV cache job: restart if OOM: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-cache`
Pending PRs: #842 (needs perf tests), #850 (docs)
```

Jordan P: Will do. Anything else re: equipment shipping while on leave?

Asha (People Ops): If you want to take laptop home, fill travel/equipment form. Otherwise we can ship spare to your address; shipping requests after leave start may be delayed.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder set: send initial LOA confirmation email template to employee and manager when Asha toggles "confirm".

Liam (Payroll): Jordan — final practical: DM me your preferred pay code (PARENTAL-PAID or FMLA-UNP) and confirm bank account on file. I'll queue changes after Asha's check.

Jordan P: Sending DM now. Really appreciate the quick responses.

Asha (People Ops): I'll pre-fill forms and toggle the confirmation once you share start date. Also adding a note to your profile for phased return (if you want gradual ramp).

Sofia (Eng Manager): Team — thanks Marco for coverage. Once Jordan posts the handoff I'll update the oncall rota. :heart:

Jordan P: Posted handoff in #eng-oncall and DMed payroll. Leaving my OOO note draft here if anyone wants to tweak: 
```
OOO: Parental leave from 2023-11-06 through 2024-01-02. For urgent infra issues ping Marco. Non-urgent: open PR comments appreciated.
```

Marco: Looks good. I'll add my cell to the rota in case pages escalate.

Asha (People Ops): Marking thread resolved for paperwork coordination. Ping if anything changes and congrats again! :purple_heart:
